gumroad.description:
**Every US facility that reported toxic chemical releases to the EPA in 2023.**

78,647 facility-chemical records. 22,000+ unique facilities. 50 states + territories.

**What's included per record:**
- Facility name + parent company
- Full street address, city, state, ZIP, county
- Latitude/longitude coordinates
- NAICS code + industry sector
- Chemical name + CAS number
- Release quantities by medium: fugitive air, stack air, water, underground injection, land
- Total on-site releases (lbs)
- Total off-site transfers (lbs)
- Carcinogen flag | PBT flag | PFAS flag | Clean Air Act flag
- EPA source URL for every row

**Direct from EPA TRI public data** — the same dataset Sustainalytics and MSCI ESG charge $10,000+/year to access.

**Who buys this:**
- Environmental compliance attorneys identifying TRI-reporting clients
- Corporate ESG/sustainability managers benchmarking facility peers
- Environmental liability insurance underwriters screening facility history
- Sustainability consultants building environmental profiles
- Environmental justice researchers tracking chemical hotspots by zip/census tract

**One-time $49 — instant CSV download. No subscription.**
